# Collections Index

This document provides a master index of all specialized collections available in the LightSpeed organization.

## Available Collections

Collections are organized by domain and contain reusable assets, templates, and reference implementations.

### Core Collections

| Collection | Purpose | Path |
|------------|---------|------|
| Agent Collections | Portable agent definitions and configurations | `.github/collections/agents/` |
| Workflow Collections | Reusable workflow definitions | `.github/collections/workflows/` |
| Template Collections | Documentation and project templates | `.github/collections/templates/` |
| Skill Collections | Modular skill implementations | `.github/collections/skills/` |

## Discovery

To discover and use collections in your projects:

1. Navigate to `.github/collections/{domain}/`
2. Review the `README.md` in each collection
3. Follow the integration guide for your use case
